auth.notes: REST API v3 uses a Consumer Key / Consumer Secret pair, sent either as HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, secret as password) or as OAuth1.0a-style query params over HTTP. No OAuth2 flow; keys are generated per WordPress user in wp-admin.

access.notes: Open-source plugin; anyone can self-host WordPress + WooCommerce for free and generate REST API keys immediately from the store's own admin, no vendor gate.

api.notes: REST API covers products, orders, customers, coupons, reports, etc. Did not confirm an official or app-specific community MCP server this pass.

verdict.rationale: Each installation is a self-hosted WordPress site the developer/merchant controls, so 'access' depends on which store instance is targeted rather than a single hosted vendor API.
